selection: Two independent maintained Python projects; current default/override resolution and proposed change impact; selected before candidate output. Project-authored tasks, not official benchmark scores.

cases.problem_statement: Assess the impact of moving default_map ahead of environment variables for ordinary Click options, without implementing the change. Trace the current base parameter value resolution and its parse-result caller. Add benchmark_navigation.json with exactly symbols, behavior, tests. symbols must map resolution and caller to source-relative file:Class.method strings. behavior must be the current four source names in descending priority (exclude prompts). tests must list one or more upstream pytest node IDs that check default_map source reporting. Read the code and run the affected tests before answering.

Assess the impact of unconditionally replacing the timeout extension in Client.send, without changing code. Trace the base request builder, timeout fill method and synchronous/asynchronous send callers. Add benchmark_navigation.json with exactly symbols, behavior, tests. symbols keys construct, fill, sync_caller, async_caller must name source-relative file:Class.method. behavior must map explicit_extensions_preserved, None_disables and unspecified_uses_client_default to their current boolean values. tests must list one or more upstream pytest node IDs checking the client timeout property. Read the implementation, check the explicit-extension and None cases, and run the affected tests.
